philippians.3.p1.b1.text: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. …

philippians.3.p1.b2.text: Watch out for those dogs, those workers of evil, those mutilators of the flesh!

philippians.3.p1.b3.text: For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—

philippians.3.p2.b1.text: though I myself could have such confidence. If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh, I have more:

philippians.3.p2.b2.text: circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin; a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;

philippians.3.p2.b3.text: as to zeal, persecuting the church; …

philippians.3.p2.b4.text: … as to righteousness in the law, faultless.

philippians.3.p3.b1.text: But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ.

philippians.3.p3.b2.text: More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, …

philippians.3.p3.b3.text: I want to know Christ and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to Him in His death,

philippians.3.p4.b1.text: Not that I have already obtained all this, or have already been made perfect, but I press on …

philippians.3.p4.b2.text: … But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead, I press on toward the goal …

philippians.3.p4.b3.text: Nevertheless, we must live up to what we have already attained.

philippians.3.p5.b1.text: Join one another in following my example, brothers, and carefully observe those who walk according to the pattern we set for you.

philippians.3.p5.b2.text: For as I have often told you before, and now say again even with tears: Many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.

philippians.3.p5.b3.text: Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, … Their minds are set on earthly things.

philippians.3.p6.b1.text: But our citizenship is in heaven, …

philippians.3.p6.b2.text: … and we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,

philippians.3.p6.b3.text: who, by the power that enables Him to subject all things to Himself, will transform our lowly bodies to be like His glorious body.
